protocols.description: Add RosetteSep™ cocktail to the blood sample and mix well.

protocols.description: Incubate the sample with RosetteSep™ cocktail for 20 minutes at room temperature.

protocols.description: Dilute the sample with an equal volume of PBS + 2% FBS and mix gently.

parameters.name: dilution ratio
parameters.description: Ratio of sample to PBS + 2% FBS

protocols.description: Layer the diluted sample on top of the density gradient medium, minimizing mixing.

protocols.description: Remove enriched cells from the density gradient medium:plasma interface, optionally removing some gradient medium to maximize recovery.

protocols.description: Wash enriched cells with PBS + 2% FBS, centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 minutes with low brake, discard supernatant.

protocols.name: Wash enriched cells (2/2)
